note: Committed suite counts, keyed by name + configuration + INVOCATION. A count is only comparable against a count taken THE SAME WAY, so every entry names the exact test-spec it was measured under and scripts/check-baselines.ps1 matches on all three -- a lane whose -Invocation has no entry here reports 'NO BASELINE -- not checked' instead of passing on slack it never earned. All six entries below are `ArcaneTests.exe "~[gpu]"`; `~[gpu]` is a BASELINE-COMPARABILITY convention, not a safety gate -- the [gpu] cases run clean on this hardware. The Jenkins lane runs the suite UNFILTERED, on an agent where [gpu] adds roughly 62000 further assertions, so it deliberately has no baseline here and reports not-checked until one is read off a real Jenkins run and committed. A drop means coverage was lost. Dist legitimately runs fewer cases than Debug/Release (6 cases / 68 assertions fewer) because of pre-existing `#if !defined(ARCANE_DIST)` guards in HostConfigTest.cpp and NriDiagnosticsTest.cpp -- that gap has been constant across this whole arc. The 2026-09-03 rise of +31 assertions / +12 cases in every configuration is Arc B's `[reference]`, `[verify]` and `[witness-unit]` unit cases, which live inside `~[gpu]`; that arc's two `[witness][gpu]` host scenarios sit OUTSIDE this filter by construction and contribute nothing here -- they are counted only by the unfiltered run.
